cities.name: Vienna
cities.local_food_tip: Classic Austrian meals such as soups, dumplings, potato dishes and traditional pastries — warm, comforting and flavorful.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Schönbrunn Palace: Vienna’s most iconic imperial residence with grand halls and golden details. → 🌳 Gardens & Gloriette Viewpoint: Perfectly landscaped paths and a panoramic terrace overlooking the city. → ☕ Schönbrunn Café: Classic Viennese coffee and apple strudel.

Afternoon: 🕍 Stephansplatz: Lively central square with street performers and shops. → ⛪ St. Stephen’s Cathedral: Gothic icon with stunning roof tiles and soaring interior. → 🛍️ Graben & Kohlmarkt: Elegant pedestrian boulevards lined with boutiques and historic façades. → 🍽️ Lunch: Viennese specialties including schnitzel, soups, dumplings and pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Belvedere Gardens: Golden-hour views over fountains, sculptures and the baroque palace.

Night: 🌃 Museum Quarter: Relaxed cafés, art courtyards and optional youth-friendly classical music venues.

ideas: 🌼 Walks Through Schönbrunn Gardens: Cherry blossoms, tulips and long elegant paths.
🌸 Belvedere Flower Terraces: Bright spring colors around fountains and ponds.
☕ Outdoor Cafés in the Old Town: Sunlit terraces offering calm spring views.
🌊 Danube Island (Donauinsel) Walks: Breezy paths and wide riverside views.
🌅 Evening City-Center Strolls: Vienna glows beautifully in summer twilight.
🍦 Gelato at Famous Viennese Ice-Cream Shops: Refreshing treats from legendary gelaterias.
🌳 Shade Walks in Prater Park: Perfect escape from the heat.
🍂 Vienna Woods Photography: Warm-toned forests and peaceful trails.
🥐 Warm Pastries in Traditional Cafés: Cozy atmosphere with classic pastries.
🖼️ Albertina & Kunsthistorisches Museum Visits: Perfect indoor cultural stops.
🎄 Rathausplatz Christmas Market: Huge festive square with lights and snacks.
✨ Belvedere Christmas Village: Beautiful palace backdrop with warm lights.
🏰 Maria-Theresien Square Market: Elegant area between two museums.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use the U-Bahn for fast access across the entire city.
🚌 Trams are perfect for short inner-city hops.
🎟️ A 24h or 48h travel pass saves money for visitors.
📱 Use the 'WienMobil' app to buy digital tickets easily.

cities.name: Hallstatt
cities.local_food_tip: Mountain-style dishes such as dumplings, lake fish, cheese plates and warm rustic pastries — simple, hearty and comforting.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Hallstatt Lake Promenade: Calm water views, mountain reflections and classic lakeside scenery. → 🏘️ Marktplatz: Traditional alpine houses and a charming village square. → 🏠 Traditional Houses Walk: Flower-decorated balconies and narrow lanes. → ☕ Lakeside Coffee Break: Warm drink with iconic mountain views.

Afternoon: 🗻 Hallstatt Skywalk: Panoramic deck high above the lake. → ⛏️ Salzwelten Salt Mine: Underground slides, tunnels and historic mining exhibits. → 🍽️ Alpine Lunch: Soups, dumplings, fish dishes and pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Lakeside Bench or Gentle Boat Ride: Golden reflections on calm water.

Night: 🌃 Lantern-Lit Lakeside Walk: Peaceful paths and quiet village cafés.

ideas: 🌼 Flower-Lined Lake Walks: Fresh blossoms decorate the promenade.
🏞️ Mountain Viewpoints: Clear spring air and green slopes.
📸 Village Photography: Soft colors and misty morning scenery.
⛵ Boat Rides on Hallstatt Lake: Scenic and refreshing.
🌳 Shaded Lakeside Paths: Cool breezes under the trees.
🍦 Gelato & Cold Drinks: Perfect for warm afternoons.
🍁 Golden Lake Reflections: Trees turn orange and reflect beautifully.
🥾 Hilltop Walks: Crunchy leaves and warm colors.
🍰 Warm Pastries & Tea: Cozy alpine cafés on cooler days.
❄️ Snow-Covered Marktplatz: The village becomes a winter postcard.
🌨️ Winter Lakeside Scenery: Peaceful, quiet and atmospheric.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses from Bad Ischl or Obertraun are the easiest access routes.
⛴️ The Hallstatt ferry connects the train station with the village center.
🚶 The entire village is walkable — most areas are pedestrian-only.
📱 Check ÖBB app for ferry & bus schedules.

cities.name: Graz
cities.local_food_tip: Styrian cuisine is known for pumpkin-seed oil, hearty soups, schnitzel variations and fresh local produce.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛰️ Schlossberg Hill: Start your day on Graz’s iconic viewpoint with forest paths and scenic overlooks. → 🕰️ Clock Tower: A medieval landmark with panoramic views. → ☕ Coffee in Hauptplatz: Relax on the main square surrounded by colorful façades.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Graz Old Town (UNESCO): Wander historic alleys, arcades and courtyards. → 🤍 Landhaus Courtyard: Renaissance architecture with elegant arches. → 🗡️ Styrian Armoury: The world’s largest historical armoury. → 🍽️ Lunch: Pumpkin soup, schnitzel, salad with pumpkin-seed oil and pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Murinsel or Schlossberg Terrace: Golden-hour views over the river and rooftops.

Night: 🌃 Kunsthaus Graz Area: Blue-lit futuristic museum and riverside evening spots.

ideas: 🌸 Blossom Trails Around Schlossberg: Colorful and photogenic.
☕ Outdoor Cafés in Old Town: Sunny and lively.
🚶 Mur River Evening Walks: Cool breezes and reflections.
🍦 Gelato in Herrengasse: Sweet summer treats.
🌳 Shaded Paths on Schlossberg: Perfect for escaping the heat.
🍁 Colorful Schlossberg Views: Warm fall tones.
🖼️ Kunsthaus & Neue Galerie: Indoor art escapes.
🎄 Hauptplatz Market: Festive lights and stalls.
🕯️ Franciscan Quarter Market: Quiet and cozy.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Graz trams cover all major points in the old town.
🚶 Most central attractions are walkable within minutes.
🎟️ A 24h ticket is perfect for quick and unlimited rides.
📱 'GrazMobil' app helps with real-time tram schedules.

cities.name: Linz
cities.local_food_tip: Try Linzer Torte, Knödel dishes, schnitzel variations and warm Austrian comfort meals.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏙️ Hauptplatz: One of Austria’s prettiest main squares with pastel façades. → 🏰 Old Town Alleys: Medieval corners and charming courtyards. → 👾 Ars Electronica Center: Interactive digital art and tech exhibits. → ☕ Coffee by the Danube.

Afternoon: 🖼️ Lentos Art Museum: Sleek glass building with contemporary art. → 🌉 Nibelungen Bridge Walk: Scenic Danube views. → 🍽️ Lunch: Knödel, soups, schnitzel or pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Walk or Schlossberg Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Art District Cafés: Relaxed, modern and creative spaces.

ideas: 🌼 Botanical Garden Walks: Fresh blooms everywhere.
🚴 Riverside Cycling: Easy and scenic paths.
🍁 Danube Park Colors: Golden and atmospheric.
🎄 Hauptplatz Market: Festive lights and treats.

public_transport_tips: 🚊 Linz tram system covers the entire center easily.
🚌 Buses connect the riverside and museums.
🎟️ Day passes are great for unlimited travel.
📱 Use 'LINZ AG Linien' app for schedules.

cities.name: Salzburg
cities.local_food_tip: Try Salzburg’s classics such as dumplings, soups, schnitzel and the famous Mozartkugel chocolate.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌺 Mirabell Palace & Gardens: Elegant baroque landscaping and fountains. → 🌉 Makartsteg Bridge: Colorful love locks and river views. → 🎼 Mozart’s Residence: Explore Mozart’s instruments and family history. → ☕ Coffee in the Old Town.

Afternoon: 🏰 Hohensalzburg Fortress: Funicular ride to panoramic medieval views. → ⛪ St. Peter’s Abbey: Peaceful monastery courtyards. → 🍽️ Lunch: Schnitzel, dumplings and pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Salzach Riverside or Kapuzinerberg Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Classical music cafés or Old Town chill spots.
public_transport_tips: 🚍 Salzburg buses connect all major attractions.
🚶 Old Town is entirely walkable.
🎟️ Day tickets are ideal for tourists.
📱 'Salzburg Verkehr' app helps track buses easily.

cities.name: Tyrol
cities.local_food_tip: Kaspressknödel, Tiroler Gröstl, hearty soups and warm alpine-style dishes define Tyrolean comfort food.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Innsbruck Old Town: Medieval pastel streets surrounded by mountain views. → ✨ Golden Roof: Innsbruck’s golden balcony landmark. → 🗼 St. Anne’s Column. → ☕ Coffee in Maria-Theresien-Straße.

Afternoon: 🚠 Nordkette Cable Car → Seegrube: Ride from the city straight up into the Alps. → 🥾 Alpine Walks with panoramic views. → 🍽️ Lunch: Tyrolean specialties.

Sunset: 🌅 Hungerburg Plateau: Spectacular golden-hour mountain scenery.

Night: 🌃 Old Town cafés or a quiet riverside walk along the Inn.

ideas: 🏞️ Lake Achensee swimming or boat rides.

public_transport_tips: 🚠 Cable cars connect the city with the mountains.
🚍 Regional buses reach lakes and hiking valleys.

cities.full_day:

Afternoon: 🌍 Minimundus Miniature World: Fun, creative and photogenic. → 🌳 Europapark: Flowers, ponds and lakeside greenery. → 🍽️ Lunch: Kasnudeln, soups or sweet pastries.

Sunset: 🌅 Wörthersee Promenade: Warm reflections and calm water.

Night: 🌃 Lakeside cafés or quiet old-town walks.
